questions.name: graph-row-normalization
questions.question: Repair effective_size so its sparse/vectorized and iterative paths agree with the structural-hole definition on weighted directed and undirected graphs. Preserve isolated-node NaN behavior, arbitrary node labels, positive-weight scaling invariance and neighboring constraint computations. Diagnose how mutual-weight normalization and the redundancy matrix interact; the weighted directed reproducer uses edges (0,1,2),(0,2,5),(1,0,3),(2,1,7). Repair general behavior, not one fixture. You may inspect both existing paths. run_reproducer also returns actual pre/post normalization rows.

provenance.trainingExposure: unknown; recency is not proof of exclusion from training

questions.name: ode-solution-coverage
questions.question: Repair dsolve result assembly after initial conditions: y''+2*y'+y=0 with y(0)=0 can return both a parameterized family and its zero specialization. Return a nonredundant solution set while retaining all mathematically distinct branches and preserving simplify=False behavior. Handle the family y''+2*a*y'+a^2*y=0 for positive integer a as well as existing nonlinear branch controls. Trace condition application, constant solving and redundancy elimination; do not discard every constant solution. run_reproducer returns current solutions and a delegated symbolic specialization witness.
